rationale: This is the same loss as claim CLM-0987 — same traveler, same 2026-07-08 phone snatch in La Candelaria, Bogota — which was already approved and paid $250, and manual section 8 sends the same loss claimed twice to the Special Investigations Unit. The claim also looks payable on its merits under section 5 of the wording (theft reported to police within 24 hours, proof of value on file, $300 Premium per-item limit less the $50 deductible = $250), so the unit should review the duplicate filing and confirm whether the earlier payment stands before anything further is paid.
